documents.text:
Project Harbor (HB-42) is a fictional customer support portal.
Nora Chen sponsors Project Harbor.
Maya Farouk is the Product Manager and owns scope and product goals.
Ethan Brooks is the Operations Lead and reviews exceptions at both warehouse sites.
Luis Ortega is the Integrations Engineer and investigates delayed source updates.
Sara Kim is the Customer Success Lead and owns support readiness.

سياسة العمل عن بعد في شركة المرفأ الخيالية.
المسؤوليات: ليلى حسن مسؤولة عن مراجعة طلبات العمل عن بعد.
الموظفون يستطيعون العمل عن بعد يومين أسبوعيًا بعد موافقة المدير.
إجراءات التقديم: يرسل الموظف الطلب قبل يوم الخميس.

The fictional Harbor remote work policy permits two remote days per week after manager approval.
Leila Hassan reviews remote work requests.
Requests must be submitted before Thursday.

Decision HB-DEC-4 for Project Harbor (HB-42): the pilot moves from 15 December 2026 to 22 December 2026.
Maya Farouk approved HB-DEC-4 because the integration test was incomplete.
This decision changes the pilot date; it does not change project ownership.

Unapproved draft for Project Harbor (HB-42): the proposed pilot date is 18 December 2026.
The draft is owned by Omar Saleh and has not superseded decision HB-DEC-4.
